newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - WellPoint started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - WellPoint started as buy.

text.p: Alex Brown said on Tuesday it started coverage of WellPoint Health Networks Inc with a buy rating and a six to 12-month price target of $60 a share.
-- Analyst Tim McGurkin said his 1997 earnings estimate was $3.15 per share and his 1998 estimate was $3.70 per share.
-- McGurkin said his buy rating was based on a proven management team with an excellent track record, an improving California market place and better liquidity for the stock.
-- He also said the company's recent acquisitions were progressing well.
